title: A send_message that says "go" or "start" on a combine, merge or ready act is checked against the filed rulings before the send
why: Incident (consultant 20:09 CST Nov 14; triage read no message; n=1): at 20:06 CST the consultant sent the coordinator a "go" to hand-build one docs-only combine of #3396, #3431, #3428, #3391 and #3430. Ruling own-826-a-now-build-b carried the gloss "no hand-built combines" (a session's reading, removed 20:17 CST Nov 14; the owner's words there are "can’t we do a while work on building b"). The coordinator caught it and held the combine; no act ran. Harm stopped: a session acting on a go the owner ruled out. Mistake class: a go on an act that a filed ruling forbids. Guard (the consultant's want): a send_message from the consultant or the coordinator that says "go" or "start" on a combine, merge or ready act is checked against origin/roadmap rulings by the same past-ruling guard that checks owner questions. First act of a lane: find where step past-ruling-on-send (the send-time judge, which today checks a question sent to the page writer) reads rulings, and whether it can read an act-word message; extend that home before building a second (rule building-one-home-per-capability; kin: relay-ruling-matches-question, which checks a relayed rule). Red then green: a send_message saying go on a combine against own-826-a is flagged before the send; a go on an act no ruling forbids passes. Rule: building-mistake-names-its-guard. INCIDENT NOTE 20:17 CST Nov 14 (consultant 20:16, relayed): the guard read a gloss, not the owner's words; the owner said 20:15 CST he never ruled against hand-built PRs like that (ruling own-848-a-hand-built-docs-combine). So the guard reads a ruling's quote, and a gloss must be labelled as a reading. Step stays.
note: Filed 20:07 CST Nov 14 by triage. Tracker: the coordinator. Queued, not started. Kin: past-ruling-on-send, relay-ruling-matches-question. Overlap read: past-ruling-on-send covers a question to the page writer only, so this is a new case on the same home.
